correctness.rationale: At least one vertex of color a and one of each b_i are necessary for the boxed subformulas to be defined and false, giving k+1. With only k+1 total, every p_bi has one fixed value and every Box_a p_bi being false forces it to be false; any accessible face defining the full disjunction then falsifies it, contradicting a true antecedent. For k+2, root r plus false states f_i and one true t_k, with maximal faces {r,f_1,...,f_(k-1),t_k} and {r,f_k}, all faces at root accessible and singleton directions elsewhere, are upward; weak-Kleene disjunction is defined only on top face where t_k is true; every consequent box has a defined false witness. Independently constructed/checked k=2..12, but general argument works without finite cutoff.

final_claim: For k>=2 and distinct agents a,b_1,...,b_k in upward directed chromatic simplicial weak-Kleene semantics, the least vertex count for a FALSE (not undefined) local-atom higher-arity independence implication is k+2; a single duplicate b_k state suffices.
limitations: Specific local-atom higher-arity schema; upward but impure complexes; cups validate Ind.
